title: Kenyan Keto Folded Bean Salad
description: A simple and flavorful salad made with folded beans, Kenyan spices, and a hint of crunch. Perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: 1. Rinse the folded beans and drain well.
2. In a small bowl, mix together Kenyan spice blend and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the spice blend mixture to the folded beans and toss to coat.
4. In a separate bowl, combine the mixed greens salad and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
5. Add the folded beans to the salad and toss to combine.
